experimentLearnings: Narrow focus presets did not represent the full source video; the source-dominant workflow prompt produced the strongest result.
NotebookLM Short is the correct first format for the intended audience; Explainer is out of scope for this experiment.
The reusable Nuglet post-processor successfully removed the provider tail, covered the NotebookLM footer, preserved audio, and added the Nuglet end card.
The post-processor improves branding and ending treatment but does not change NotebookLM's visual style.
